title: Managed-hosting topology manifest (DEP-02)
description: Repository-only topology declaration for the ADR-0010 managed-hosting pilot. No component is provisioned, deployed, or live. Every entitlement, pricing, residency, and owner item remains PENDING owner verification. Failure domains and scale triggers are proposals for DEP-02; they are not measured isolation or capacity claims.

components.name: Web / API
components.role: Recruiter browser client and screening API (Next.js web plus Node API). Primary application plane for the pilot.
components.notes: Scale trigger thresholds are proposals awaiting owner/SRE input; no measured capacity conclusion exists.

components.name: LiveKit Cloud (SFU Build)
components.role: Managed WebRTC SFU per ADR-0010 decision 1.
components.notes: Account, entitlement, pricing, and residency verification PENDING owner.

components.name: LiveKit Cloud Agents
components.role: Managed Python voice worker runtime per ADR-0010 decision 1.

scaleTriggers.thresholdProposed: owner/SRE-defined once the owner provisions Cloud Agents (PENDING)

components.notes: Cloud Agents deployment and entitlements PENDING owner.

components.name: Supabase
components.role: Postgres, auth, and storage backend for the screening platform.

scaleTriggers.thresholdProposed: owner/SRE-defined after entitlement and residency evidence

components.notes: Capacity entitlement and region residency evidence PENDING owner.

components.name: Managed Infisical
components.role: Runtime secret injection via machine identity per ADR-0010 decision 2.

scaleTriggers.thresholdProposed: owner/SRE-defined after project and machine identity creation

components.notes: Project creation, machine identity, and scope PENDING owner.

components.name: OCI E2 Micro Gateway / Fallback
components.role: Lightweight gateway and fallback only per ADR-0010 decision 3; not the primary worker host.

scaleTriggers.thresholdProposed: owner/SRE-defined; existing instance only, no Terraform change accompanies this manifest

components.notes: Existing instance role confirmation PENDING owner. No Oracle Terraform is modified or extended by Phase 11 repository work.

components.name: Bounded near-India VPS Fallback
components.role: Persistent near-India VPS bounded to an internal USD 12 monthly engineering ceiling per ADR-0010 decision 4, if Cloud Agents proves unsuitable.

scaleTriggers.thresholdProposed: owner decision only; provider and region PENDING verification

components.notes: Provider, region, and the USD 12 ceiling are internal engineering bounds PENDING owner verification, not provider quotes.

externalPending: LiveKit Cloud project and Cloud Agents deployment
Managed Infisical project and machine identity
Supabase capacity entitlement and region residency evidence
VPS provider, region, and monthly ceiling verification
SRE approval for target concurrency and headroom
Provider pricing, DPA, and residency evidence for every managed component
